PEN_CLICKER.name: Pen Clicker
PEN_CLICKER.description: Constantly clicks pens during interviews or judging. Annoys the audio department.

KNEE_BOUNCER.name: Knee Bouncer
KNEE_BOUNCER.description: Their leg never stops shaking when they sit down. Shows high nervous energy.

NAIL_BITER.name: Nail Biter
NAIL_BITER.description: Chews their nails down to the quick whenever elimination day approaches.

HAIR_TWIRLER.name: Hair Twirler
HAIR_TWIRLER.description: Subconsciously plays with their hair when bored or thinking.

LIP_BITER.name: Lip Biter
LIP_BITER.description: Bites their lip when focusing hard on choreography. Fans find it highly endearing.

KNUCKLE_CRACKER.name: Knuckle Cracker
KNUCKLE_CRACKER.description: Loudly pops their joints before stepping on stage. Intimidating to some.

NECK_CRACKER.name: Neck Cracker
NECK_CRACKER.description: Rolls and pops their neck when tension is high in the practice room.

CLOTHING_ADJUSTER.name: Clothing Adjuster
CLOTHING_ADJUSTER.description: Constantly tugging at their shirt hem or fixing their collar on camera.

RING_SPINNER.name: Ring Spinner
RING_SPINNER.description: Fidgets with their jewelry during serious conversations.

TONGUE_CLICKER.name: Tongue Clicker
TONGUE_CLICKER.description: Makes a 'tsk' or clicking sound when they are thinking of an answer.

TEETH_GRINDER.name: Teeth Grinder
TEETH_GRINDER.description: Clenches their jaw visibly when receiving harsh feedback.

EYE_RUBBER.name: Eye Rubber
EYE_RUBBER.description: Rubs their eyes frequently, always looking slightly exhausted.

NOSE_SCRUNCHER.name: Nose Scruncher
NOSE_SCRUNCHER.description: Scrunches their nose when they laugh or are confused. A highly meme-able trait.

HEAD_SCRATCHER.name: Head Scratcher
HEAD_SCRATCHER.description: Literally scratches the back of their head when they make a mistake.

FOOT_TAPPER.name: Foot Tapper
FOOT_TAPPER.description: Always tapping out a beat with their foot, even when sitting still.

WATCH_CHECKER.name: Watch Checker
WATCH_CHECKER.description: Looks at their wrist habitually, even when they aren't wearing a watch.

POCKET_JINGLER.name: Pocket Jingler
POCKET_JINGLER.description: Keeps their hands in their pockets and jingles coins or keys when nervous.

COLLAR_TUGGER.name: Collar Tugger
COLLAR_TUGGER.description: Pulls at their collar when asked a difficult question by a judge.

SHOELACE_TYER.name: Shoelace Tyer
SHOELACE_TYER.description: Bends down to retie their perfectly fine shoelaces just to avoid eye contact.

SLEEVE_PULLER.name: Sleeve Puller
SLEEVE_PULLER.description: Pulls their sleeves down over their hands when feeling shy or cold.

LOUD_LAUGHER.name: Loud Laugher
LOUD_LAUGHER.description: Has a booming, distinct laugh that echoes across the studio.

MUMBLER.name: Mumbler
MUMBLER.description: Speaks quietly and trails off. Producers always have to subtitle them.

INTERRUPTER.name: Interrupter
INTERRUPTER.description: Gets too excited and constantly talks over other people.

OVERSHARER.name: Oversharer
OVERSHARER.description: Tells deeply personal stories to people they met five minutes ago.

DEADPAN.name: Deadpan
DEADPAN.description: Delivers jokes with absolutely zero facial expression.

FILLER_WORD_ABUSER.name: Filler Word Abuser
FILLER_WORD_ABUSER.description: Says 'like' or 'literally' between every single word.

TALKS_TO_SELF.name: Talks to Self
TALKS_TO_SELF.description: Mumbles choreo counts or pep talks to themselves in the hallway.

FAST_TALKER.name: Fast Talker
FAST_TALKER.description: Speaks at 100 miles an hour when they get nervous or excited.

SLOW_TALKER.name: Slow Talker
SLOW_TALKER.description: Takes a very, very long time to finish a thought.

WHISPERER.name: Whisperer
WHISPERER.description: Treats every piece of mundane information like it's a massive secret.

CHRONIC_APOLOGIZER.name: Chronic Apologizer
CHRONIC_APOLOGIZER.description: Says 'sorry' to inanimate objects when they bump into them.

OVER_EXPLAINER.name: Over-Explainer
OVER_EXPLAINER.description: Gives a five-minute backstory to answer a simple yes or no question.

UNINTENTIONAL_RHYMER.name: Unintentional Rhymer
UNINTENTIONAL_RHYMER.description: Accidentally speaks in rhymes, making them sound like Dr. Seuss.

ECHOER.name: Echoer
ECHOER.description: Repeats the last word of whatever the person before them just said.

SIGH_MASTER.name: Sigh Master
SIGH_MASTER.description: Breathes out heavy, dramatic sighs when mildly inconvenienced.

BREATHY_TALKER.name: Breathy Talker
BREATHY_TALKER.description: Always sounds like they just finished running a mile when they speak.

VOLUME_ESCALATOR.name: Volume Escalator
VOLUME_ESCALATOR.description: Starts a sentence quietly and ends up shouting by the end of it.

CLOSE_TALKER.name: Close Talker
CLOSE_TALKER.description: Stands way too close to people during casual conversation.

INTENSE_STARER.name: Intense Starer
INTENSE_STARER.description: Makes unbreakable eye contact when listening to someone.

EYE_CONTACT_AVOIDER.name: Eye Contact Avoider
EYE_CONTACT_AVOIDER.description: Looks at the floor, the ceiling, or the wall—anywhere but the person's eyes.

HAND_TALKER.name: Hand Talker
HAND_TALKER.description: Uses massive hand gestures. Dangerous to stand next to them when they are excited.

SHOULDER_TOUCHER.name: Shoulder Toucher
SHOULDER_TOUCHER.description: Always taps or squeezes someone's shoulder when talking to them.

AGGRESSIVE_POINTER.name: Aggressive Pointer
AGGRESSIVE_POINTER.description: Points directly at people's chests when making an argument.

CHRONIC_HIGH_FIVER.name: Chronic High-Fiver
CHRONIC_HIGH_FIVER.description: Offers a high-five for absolutely every minor achievement.

HUG_INITIATOR.name: Hug Initiator
HUG_INITIATOR.description: Greets everyone with a full bear hug instead of a handshake.

SPACE_INVADER.name: Space Invader
SPACE_INVADER.description: Has zero concept of the personal bubble. Will sit on the same chair as someone else.

NICKNAME_GIVER.name: Nickname Giver
NICKNAME_GIVER.description: Refuses to use real names. Gives everyone a weird, mildly offensive nickname.

NAME_FORGETTER.name: Name Forgetter
NAME_FORGETTER.description: Calls people 'bro' or 'man' because they still don't know anyone's name by Episode 4.

CHRONIC_WINKER.name: Chronic Winker
CHRONIC_WINKER.description: Winks at people as a greeting. Sometimes charming, sometimes creepy.

GOSSIP_WHISPERER.name: Gossip Whisperer
GOSSIP_WHISPERER.description: Covers their mouth with their hand when talking, even if they aren't saying a secret.

SARCASTIC_AGREER.name: Sarcastic Agreer
SARCASTIC_AGREER.description: Says 'Totally' or 'Right' in a tone that implies they completely disagree.

COMPLIMENT_DEFLECTOR.name: Compliment Deflector
COMPLIMENT_DEFLECTOR.description: Physically cringes and changes the subject when someone praises them.

OVER_AGREER.name: Over-Agreer
OVER_AGREER.description: Nods their head vigorously the entire time someone else is speaking.

DEVILS_ADVOCATE.name: Devil's Advocate
DEVILS_ADVOCATE.description: Always takes the opposing side in trivial dorm debates just for the sake of arguing.

MUNDANE_ONE_UPPER.name: Mundane One-Upper
MUNDANE_ONE_UPPER.description: If you slept 4 hours, they slept 3. Always has to slightly edge out your casual stories.

THE_DEFLECTOR.name: The Deflector
THE_DEFLECTOR.description: Answers every question with another question.

SELF_LAUGHER.name: Self-Laugher
SELF_LAUGHER.description: Starts laughing before they even finish the punchline to their own joke.

NERVOUS_LAUGHER.name: Nervous Laugher
NERVOUS_LAUGHER.description: Chuckles inappropriately when receiving bad news or harsh critiques.

SILENT_JUDGER.name: Silent Judger
SILENT_JUDGER.description: Squints slightly and purses their lips when they hear a bad idea, saying nothing.

ALWAYS_COLD.name: Always Cold
ALWAYS_COLD.description: Wears hoodies and sweatpants even during intense summer dance practices.

ALWAYS_HOT.name: Always Hot
ALWAYS_HOT.description: Sleeps with no blankets and constantly opens the dorm windows in winter.

HEAVY_WALKER.name: Heavy Walker
HEAVY_WALKER.description: Stomps around the dorm. You can hear them coming from down the hall.

DOOR_SLAMMER.name: Door Slammer
DOOR_SLAMMER.description: Never gently closes a door. Everything is shut with maximum force.

THE_HUMMER.name: The Hummer
THE_HUMMER.description: Constantly humming whatever song they are currently stuck practicing.

SHOWER_SINGER.name: Shower Singer
SHOWER_SINGER.description: Belts out high notes in the dorm bathroom at 6 AM.

SLEEP_TALKER.name: Sleep Talker
SLEEP_TALKER.description: Has full conversations in their sleep, terrified roommates.

ALARM_SNOOZER.name: Alarm Snoozer
ALARM_SNOOZER.description: Sets five alarms and hits snooze on all of them.

BAREFOOT_WALKER.name: Barefoot Walker
BAREFOOT_WALKER.description: Refuses to wear socks or slippers in the shared spaces.

BLANKET_HOG.name: Blanket Hog
BLANKET_HOG.description: Steals all the covers if they ever have to share a bed or couch.

CHRONIC_BORROWER.name: Chronic Borrower
CHRONIC_BORROWER.description: Always needs to borrow toothpaste, socks, or a charger.

MESSY_EATER.name: Messy Eater
MESSY_EATER.description: Always manages to drop crumbs or spill sauce on their practice shirts.

FAST_EATER.name: Fast Eater
FAST_EATER.description: Inhales their food in three minutes so they can get back to practicing.

SLOW_EATER.name: Slow Eater
SLOW_EATER.description: Takes an hour to finish a single sandwich, talking the entire time.

ICE_CHEWER.name: Ice Chewer
ICE_CHEWER.description: Loudly crunches the ice at the bottom of their drink cups.

GUM_SMACKER.name: Gum Smacker
GUM_SMACKER.description: Chews their gum with their mouth open.

WATER_CHUGGER.name: Water Chugger
WATER_CHUGGER.description: Always carrying a massive gallon jug of water and chugging it aggressively.

CONSTANT_SNACKER.name: Constant Snacker
CONSTANT_SNACKER.description: Always has a granola bar or bag of chips in their hand.

ALWAYS_HAS_TISSUES.name: Always Has Tissues
ALWAYS_HAS_TISSUES.description: The prepared one. Always has a tissue ready for crying teammates.

PHONE_CHECKER.name: Phone Checker
PHONE_CHECKER.description: Lights up their phone screen every two minutes just to check the time.

STRESS_CLEANER.name: Stress Cleaner
STRESS_CLEANER.description: Starts aggressively scrubbing the dorm kitchen when they are nervous about a ranking.

THE_PACER.name: The Pacer
THE_PACER.description: Walks in endless circles around the practice room while memorizing lyrics.

BLANK_STARER.name: Blank Starer
BLANK_STARER.description: Zones out completely when overwhelmed, staring into the void.

TONGUE_BITER.name: Tongue Biter
TONGUE_BITER.description: Sticks their tongue out of the side of their mouth when deeply focused.

BREATH_HOLDER.name: Breath Holder
BREATH_HOLDER.description: Subconsciously holds their breath during tense ranking announcements.

MUTTERER.name: Mutterer
MUTTERER.description: Whispers complaints to themselves under their breath when frustrated.

FACE_HIDER.name: Face Hider
FACE_HIDER.description: Buries their face in their hands whenever they are embarrassed or stressed.

THE_ROCKER.name: The Rocker
THE_ROCKER.description: Rocks back and forth on their heels when standing in front of the judges.

STRESS_EATER.name: Stress Eater
STRESS_EATER.description: Demolishes the craft services table right before a big performance.

APPETITE_LOSER.name: Appetite Loser
APPETITE_LOSER.description: Cannot stomach a single bite of food on stage days.

EYEBROW_RAISER.name: Eyebrow Raiser
EYEBROW_RAISER.description: Constantly speaks with one eyebrow raised, making them look permanently skeptical.

HEAD_TILTER.name: Head Tilter
HEAD_TILTER.description: Tilts their head like a confused puppy when receiving instructions.

GHOST_SMILE.name: Ghost Smile
GHOST_SMILE.description: Maintains a frozen, dead-eyed smile when they are secretly panicking.

SHOULDER_SHRUGGER.name: Shoulder Shrugger
SHOULDER_SHRUGGER.description: Shrugs constantly instead of giving verbal answers.

PEN_CHEWER.name: Pen Chewer
PEN_CHEWER.description: Destroys the caps of all their pens while writing lyrics.

NAIL_TAPPER.name: Nail Tapper
NAIL_TAPPER.description: Taps their fingernails rhythmically on every hard surface.

CLOCK_WATCHER.name: Clock Watcher
CLOCK_WATCHER.description: Their eyes constantly dart to the clock during long rehearsals.

SWEATY_PALMS.name: Sweaty Palms
SWEATY_PALMS.description: Constantly wiping their hands on their jeans before holding a microphone.

YAWNER_WHEN_NERVOUS.name: Yawner When Nervous
YAWNER_WHEN_NERVOUS.description: Yawns excessively when stressed, which mentors often mistake for laziness.

NOSE_PICKER.name: Nose Picker
NOSE_PICKER.description: Subconsciously picks their nose when deep in thought. A nightmare for editors.

THROAT_CLEARER.name: Throat Clearer
THROAT_CLEARER.description: Constantly clears their throat before speaking, ruining clean audio takes.

SNIFFER.name: Sniffer
SNIFFER.description: Sniffs audibly instead of blowing their nose. Deeply annoying in quiet rooms.

SLEEVE_CHEWER.name: Sleeve Chewer
SLEEVE_CHEWER.description: Chews on the strings of their hoodies when nervous.

LIP_PEELER.name: Lip Peeler
LIP_PEELER.description: Picks at dry skin on their lips constantly. Highly visual and distracting.

NECK_SCRATCHER.name: Neck Scratcher
NECK_SCRATCHER.description: Rubs the back of their neck whenever they are lying or embarrassed.

EYE_TWITCHER.name: Eye Twitcher
EYE_TWITCHER.description: One eye twitches visibly when they are angry or exhausted.

HAIR_FLIPPER.name: Hair Flipper
HAIR_FLIPPER.description: Constantly whips their head to get hair out of their eyes instead of tying it back.

LOUD_SIGHER.name: Loud Sigher
LOUD_SIGHER.description: Lets out dramatic, heavy sighs when bored or mildly inconvenienced.

OVER_NODDER.name: Over-Nodder
OVER_NODDER.description: Nods their head aggressively the entire time someone else is speaking.

NAME_REPEATER.name: Name Repeater
NAME_REPEATER.description: Uses the other person's name constantly in conversation ('Well, John, I think...').

SENTENCE_FINISHER.name: Sentence Finisher
SENTENCE_FINISHER.description: Always tries to guess the end of the other person's sentence out loud.

MONOTONE_SPEAKER.name: Monotone Speaker
MONOTONE_SPEAKER.description: Speaks with absolutely zero pitch fluctuation. Very hard to read emotionally.

GASPER.name: Gasper
GASPER.description: Reacts to even mild news with a sharp, audible intake of breath.

OVER_COMPLIMENTER.name: Over-Complimenter
OVER_COMPLIMENTER.description: Lays praise on so thick it starts to sound sarcastic.

CHEEK_PUFFER.name: Cheek Puffer
CHEEK_PUFFER.description: Puffs out their cheeks and exhales when frustrated during choreography.

CHIN_STROKER.name: Chin Stroker
CHIN_STROKER.description: Strokes their chin thoughtfully whenever a mentor speaks.

POINTING_TALKER.name: Pointing Talker
POINTING_TALKER.description: Points directly at the person they are speaking to. Can feel aggressive.

SLOUCHER.name: Sloucher
SLOUCHER.description: Has terrible posture when sitting on the waiting room couches.

STIFF_WALKER.name: Stiff Walker
STIFF_WALKER.description: Walks without swinging their arms. Looks like a marching soldier.

CLAPPING_LAUGHER.name: Clapping Laugher
CLAPPING_LAUGHER.description: Cannot laugh without enthusiastically clapping their hands.

SNORTER.name: Snorter
SNORTER.description: Lets out a loud snort when they laugh too hard, then gets embarrassed.

CHEST_PATTER.name: Chest Patter
CHEST_PATTER.description: Pats their own chest to calm their heartbeat before going on stage.

FOOT_SHUFFLER.name: Foot Shuffler
FOOT_SHUFFLER.description: Drags their feet when walking, making a scuffing sound in the halls.

POSTURE_CORRECTOR.name: Posture Corrector
POSTURE_CORRECTOR.description: Rolls their shoulders back and sits up straight when they spot a camera.

HARD_SWALLOWER.name: Hard Swallower
HARD_SWALLOWER.description: Gulps audibly when nervous or receiving judges' scores.

HEEL_ROCKER.name: Heel Rocker
HEEL_ROCKER.description: Rocks back and forth on their heels when standing in line.

AIR_PUNCHER.name: Air Puncher
AIR_PUNCHER.description: Celebrates small victories with a tiny, aggressive fist pump.

TEETH_CLICKER.name: Teeth Clicker
TEETH_CLICKER.description: Rhythmically taps their teeth together when reading.

HAPPY_CRIER.name: Happy Crier
HAPPY_CRIER.description: Bursts into tears when they get a good grade.

ANGRY_CRIER.name: Angry Crier
ANGRY_CRIER.description: Gets teary-eyed when frustrated, which makes them angrier.

POUTER.name: Pouter
POUTER.description: Sticks their bottom lip out unconsciously when they don't get their way.

NOSTRIL_FLARER.name: Nostril Flarer
NOSTRIL_FLARER.description: Nose flares visibly when trying not to snap at a judge.

RED_BLUSHER.name: Red Blusher
RED_BLUSHER.description: Ears and neck turn bright red the second they are put on the spot.

HAND_WRINGER.name: Hand Wringer
HAND_WRINGER.description: Twists their hands together painfully when watching friends face elimination.

WINCE_SMILE.name: Wince-Smile
WINCE_SMILE.description: Smiles through the pain when receiving a terrible grade.

BLINKING_STARRER.name: Blinking Starrer
BLINKING_STARRER.description: Stares without blinking for uncomfortably long periods of time.

HUMMING_THINKER.name: Humming Thinker
HUMMING_THINKER.description: Hums a single note when trying to remember something.

YAWNING_STRETCHER.name: Yawning Stretcher
YAWNING_STRETCHER.description: Makes a loud vocal noise whenever they stretch.

CHEEK_BITER.name: Cheek Biter
CHEEK_BITER.description: Chews the inside of their cheek when anxious.

LIP_PURSOR.name: Lip Pursor
LIP_PURSOR.description: Purses their lips tightly when disagreeing but staying silent.

FINGER_DRUMMER.name: Finger Drummer
FINGER_DRUMMER.description: Taps out rhythms on their legs during quiet moments.

EAR_TAGGER.name: Ear Tagger
EAR_TAGGER.description: Pulls on their earlobe when confused.

THUMB_TWIDDLER.name: Thumb Twiddler
THUMB_TWIDDLER.description: Folds hands and twiddles thumbs when waiting patiently.

SHOE_SCUFFER.name: Shoe Scuffer
SHOE_SCUFFER.description: Kicks the ground lightly when feeling awkward.

WRIST_GRABBER.name: Wrist Grabber
WRIST_GRABBER.description: Holds their own wrist behind their back when standing still.

NECK_RUBBER.name: Neck Rubber
NECK_RUBBER.description: Rubs the back of their neck when apologizing.

EYE_ROLLER.name: Eye Roller
EYE_ROLLER.description: Cannot control their eyes rolling when they hear something stupid.

LIP_SMACKER.name: Lip Smacker
LIP_SMACKER.description: Smacks their lips loudly before starting a sentence.

WORD_STUMBLER.name: Word Stumbler
WORD_STUMBLER.description: Trips over their words when excited, requiring a restart.

WHISPER_YELLER.name: Whisper Yeller
WHISPER_YELLER.description: Tries to whisper but is still incredibly loud.

QUESTION_REPEATER.name: Question Repeater
QUESTION_REPEATER.description: Repeats the question out loud before answering it.

STORY_EXAGGERATOR.name: Story Exaggerator
STORY_EXAGGERATOR.description: Always makes their anecdotes 10% more dramatic than reality.

VOCAL_FRY.name: Vocal Fry
VOCAL_FRY.description: Speaks with a heavy, crackling vocal fry. Very polarizing.

UP_TALKER.name: Up-Talker
UP_TALKER.description: Ends every sentence sounding like a question?

MOUTH_BREATHER.name: Mouth Breather
MOUTH_BREATHER.description: Breathes audibly through their mouth when resting.

NOSE_WHISTLER.name: Nose Whistler
NOSE_WHISTLER.description: Has a faint whistle in their nose when they breathe.

THROAT_SINGER.name: Throat Singer
THROAT_SINGER.description: Makes weird, deep guttural noises to clear their vocal cords.

LIP_TRILLER.name: Lip Triller
LIP_TRILLER.description: Constantly doing vocal warmups (lip trills) in the dorm.

PITCH_MATCHER.name: Pitch Matcher
PITCH_MATCHER.description: Subconsciously tries to harmonize with random background noises.

CAMERA_GLANCER.name: Camera Glancer
CAMERA_GLANCER.description: Cannot stop looking directly into the camera lens during group shots.

MARK_MISSER.name: Mark Misser
MARK_MISSER.description: Always stands slightly off their designated X on stage.

OVER_DANCER.name: Over-Dancer
OVER_DANCER.description: Puts 150% energy into every move, often looking out of sync with the group.

LIP_SYNCER.name: Lip-Syncer
LIP_SYNCER.description: Mouths the words to other people's parts when they are not singing.

WINK_ABUSER.name: Wink Abuser
WINK_ABUSER.description: Winks at the camera too much. Goes from charming to cringe quickly.

SWEAT_WIPER.name: Sweat Wiper
SWEAT_WIPER.description: Constantly wiping their forehead on stage, ruining the sleek image.

MIC_DROPPER.name: Mic Dropper
MIC_DROPPER.description: Clumsy with the microphone. Has dropped it twice in rehearsals.

HEAVY_BREATHER.name: Heavy Breather
HEAVY_BREATHER.description: Breathes directly into the mic after a dance break.

STARING_CONTEST.name: Staring Contest
STARING_CONTEST.description: Locks eyes with one specific audience member for an uncomfortable amount of time.

CHOREO_MUTTERER.name: Choreo Mutterer
CHOREO_MUTTERER.description: You can clearly see them mouthing '1, 2, 3, 4' during the dance.

WARDROBE_FIDGETER.name: Wardrobe Fidgeter
WARDROBE_FIDGETER.description: Pulls down their jacket or hikes up their pants mid-performance.

EARLY_ENTRANT.name: Early Entrant
EARLY_ENTRANT.description: Always steps forward a half-second too early for their solo.

LATE_EXIT.name: Late Exit
LATE_EXIT.description: Lingers in the center for a second too long after their part is over.

FAKE_CRIER.name: Fake Crier
FAKE_CRIER.description: Forces tears during emotional ballads to get a better edit.

OVER_BOWER.name: Over-Bower
OVER_BOWER.description: Bows at a perfect 90-degree angle for far too long after a set.

SALUTER.name: Saluter
SALUTER.description: Always ends a performance with a cheesy two-finger salute.

FINGER_GUNNER.name: Finger Gunner
FINGER_GUNNER.description: Shoots finger guns at the judges when they get a compliment.

LIP_BITER_STAGE.name: Lip Biter (Stage)
LIP_BITER_STAGE.description: Does a highly choreographed lip bite during their center time.

HAIR_BRUSHER.name: Hair Brusher
HAIR_BRUSHER.description: Runs their hand through their hair dramatically before the beat drops.

JACKET_DROPPER.name: Jacket Dropper
JACKET_DROPPER.description: Always lets one side of their jacket slide off their shoulder.

MIC_STAND_LEANER.name: Mic Stand Leaner
MIC_STAND_LEANER.description: Leans way too far back on the mic stand. Looks cool until they fall.

SPINNING_ADDICT.name: Spinning Addict
SPINNING_ADDICT.description: Adds an unnecessary spin to every walking transition on stage.

FLOOR_LOOKER.name: Floor Looker
FLOOR_LOOKER.description: Looks at the floor during dance breaks instead of the audience.

CEILING_STARRER.name: Ceiling Starrer
CEILING_STARRER.description: Looks up at the rafters when hitting a high note. Dramatic but disconnects from the crowd.

AGGRESSIVE_STOMPER.name: Aggressive Stomper
AGGRESSIVE_STOMPER.description: Hits the stage floor so hard during dance breaks you can hear it over the music.

BREATH_CATCHER.name: Breath Catcher
BREATH_CATCHER.description: Visibly completely out of breath the second the music stops.

ENDING_FAIRY_FREEZE.name: Ending Fairy Freeze
ENDING_FAIRY_FREEZE.description: Holds their final pose so perfectly still they look like a statue.

WOBBLER.name: Wobbler
WOBBLER.description: Always loses their balance slightly on the final pose.

PANTING_SMILER.name: Panting Smiler
PANTING_SMILER.description: Tries to smile through intense physical exhaustion. Looks slightly unhinged.

TEAR_WIPER.name: Tear Wiper
TEAR_WIPER.description: Wipes away non-existent sweat/tears to look like they worked harder.

MIC_SWITCHER.name: Mic Switcher
MIC_SWITCHER.description: Constantly moves the mic from left hand to right hand for no reason.

CORD_TRIPPER.name: Cord Tripper
CORD_TRIPPER.description: Always getting tangled in the microphone cord if it isn't wireless.

OVER_SINGER.name: Over-Singer
OVER_SINGER.description: Adds too many runs and riffs to a simple vocal line.

UNDER_SINGER.name: Under-Singer
UNDER_SINGER.description: Sings so quietly the sound engineers have to boost their mic.

PITCH_SLIDER.name: Pitch Slider
PITCH_SLIDER.description: Always scoops up to a note instead of hitting it dead on.

AGGRESSIVE_POPPER.name: Aggressive Popper
AGGRESSIVE_POPPER.description: Hits the 'P' and 'T' sounds so hard it pops the microphone.

NASAL_SINGER.name: Nasal Singer
NASAL_SINGER.description: Sings entirely through their nose when they get nervous.

BREATH_SKIPPER.name: Breath Skipper
BREATH_SKIPPER.description: Forgets to breathe in the right spots and runs out of air mid-sentence.

JAW_CLENCHER.name: Jaw Clencher
JAW_CLENCHER.description: Sings with a tight jaw, making them look angry during ballads.

NOSE_BUMPER.name: Nose Bumper
NOSE_BUMPER.description: Subconsciously taps the tip of their nose when deep in thought.

CUTICLE_PICKER.name: Cuticle Picker
CUTICLE_PICKER.description: Constantly picks at their cuticles, distracting themselves and others.
